Unboxing

  • Akaar 3D printer comes with a well-packed consignment.
  • Unwrap the box and remove the printer out of the box.

WarningFor the safety of printer and personnel, it is always recommended to have two persons while handling lifting.

  • Remove the protective cover. You can tilt the bottom while removing from the bottom.
  • Place the printer on a flat surface. 
  • Open the front door and remove the tool kit (REMOVE THE FOAMS).Make sure there are no foams left inside the printer.

Product Overview


Note
  • These images illustrate the fixed components of the Akaar Printer.
  • The filament holder, USB Flash Drive and WiFi Antenna are removable.

Installation

Before you start using Akaar E1 3D printer, do the steps that follow to setup the printer for seamless operation.

Step 1 – Remove transport locks

  1. Identify the transport locks (4) on both sides of guideway ends.
  2. Use L-shaped screwdriver (size-2) to loosen the screws.
  3. Preserve the locks for future use. 


Step 2 – Install Auxiliary Fan Casing

Carefully place the magnetic casing on the auxiliary fan.


Step 3 – Remove guideway covers

  1. Identify the guideway covers (2) on either sides of the extruder and use scissors to cut the tie-straps.
  2. Gently lift the covers upwards.


Step 4 – Remove camera protective cover

Carefully remove the protective cover on the camera.

Step 5 – Install Filament Holder

Place the filament holder and rotate clockwise till the spaces sit on the lock.


Step 6 – Remove LCD Screen Cover

Carefully remove the cover on the LCD screen.

Step 7 – Install WiFi Antenna

Place the antenna on the port and rotate the nut clockwise.


Step 8 – Install Power Cord

Plug in the power cord on the power socket of printer.


Step 9 – Install USB Flash Drive

Install the USB Flash Drive on the USB 2.0 ports.

Connect

  1. Connect the other end of power cord to the power source.
  2. Power ON the switch on the printer.
  3. Make sure that the LCD screen turns on with the logo.
  4. Allow few minutes to the printer to boot up.
  5. Makes sure the setup screen appears.
  6. Tap START to begin the setup.
  7. Wait for the printer to search networks.
  8. Select your WiFi network and tap NEXT.
  9. Enter the password and tap  ✔.

Safety Guidelines

Always entrust operations such as transportation and unloading to trained professionals. Suitable equipment and technical skills are required in handling the machine.

Warning Tasks that require undue effort may result in a major accident.

Choose a quiet, clean, well-lit location with a stable, level surface that can safely support the printer's weight (up to 26 kg / 57.4 lb). Position the printer next to a power outlet, ensuring the power plug remains easily accessible for quick disconnection in an emergency.

Avoid installing the printer in locations with extreme temperature or humidity changes, vibration, uneven or unstable floors, excessive dust, or direct sunlight, as these conditions can lead to faulty operation, breakdowns, or safety hazards.
